title: Mission Patches and Other Symbols
slide_intent: Distinguish the identity of a mission from the identity of the agency. Giving each symbol space lets the viewer understand what it represents.
strategic_value: NASA can preserve the personality of an individual mission while maintaining a recognizable agency signature for the work it oversees.
demonstration: Two distinct mission patches appear as separate specimens below the guidance. Apollo 11 is circular and the GTA-6 patch has a polygonal outline.
practical_value: When a mission patch accompanies agency identification, give it its own visual space as the manual directs.

content_islands.name: Mission guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the title and explanation of patches in the top columns.

content_islands.name: Apollo 11 specimen
content_islands.spec: Center the circular mission patch within a broad white band between horizontal rules.

content_islands.name: GTA-6 specimen
content_islands.spec: Center the second patch in its own band. Keep its outline and internal lettering intact.
